checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals onboarding-sequence, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals onboarding-sequence.

checks.description: The flow is an ordered, reusable shape, each message with trigger, segment, channel, and a copy variant ref.
checks.rule: Output flow lists ordered messages, each with id, trigger, segment, channel, copy_ref, and subject_ref.

checks.description: Each message references a QA-passed copy variant by id; the flow never writes copy.
checks.rule: Body states each message binds to a QA-passed copy-package variant id and that the flow sequences copy and does not write it.

checks.description: Activation branches on the first step; not-yet-activated users get a gentle retry, not a louder pitch.
checks.rule: Body states the activation message branches and gives not-yet-activated users a gentle retry rather than a louder pitch.

checks.description: The sub-skill carries both the WELCOME and the ONBOARDING / activation patterns, selected by audience and objective.
checks.rule: Body presents a WELCOME pattern (new subscriber, relationship and first conversion) and an ONBOARDING / activation pattern (new signup or trial, activation), selected by the brief's audience and objective.

checks.description: WELCOME is 5 to 6 emails, email 1 within 5 minutes, cadence every 2 to 3 days, never daily.
checks.rule: Body states WELCOME is 5 to 6 emails with email 1 within 5 minutes of signup, day 2 to 3, day 5 to 7, day 7 to 14, cadence every 2 to 3 days, never daily.

checks.description: Onboarding email count scales to the window: 7-day trial gets 5, 14-day gets 7, 30-day gets 8 to 10; general band 5 to 8 over 7 to 14 days.
checks.rule: Body states a 7-day trial gets a compressed 5-email sequence, a 14-day window gets 7, a 30-day window gets 8 to 10 over 2 to 3 weeks, general band 5 to 8 over 7 to 14 days.

checks.description: Onboarding anchors on 5 types: welcome, usage tips, sales touch, usage review, expiry warning.
checks.rule: Body names the 5 anchor types: welcome, usage tips, sales touch, usage review, expiry warning.

checks.description: A time-based foundation every new user gets, with behavior-triggered emails layered on top.
checks.rule: Body states a time-based foundation (for example a setup guide on day 1) with behavior-triggered emails layered on top (for example a help email if setup not done by day 3).

checks.description: The welcome or first touch is instant; morning local sends 8 AM to 10 AM perform best for the rest.
checks.rule: Body states the welcome is instant and morning local sends roughly 8 AM to 10 AM tend to perform best for the rest of the arc.

checks.description: The onboarding success metric is the activation rate (reaching the milestone), not open or click rate.
checks.rule: Body states the onboarding success metric is the activation rate, how many reach the defined milestone, and that it is not open or click rate.

checks.description: Audience size is resolved from live data at send time.
checks.rule: Body and output state audience_size is resolved at send from live data.

checks.description: A one plain sentence send_on_approval describes what the send does and to how many.
checks.rule: Output includes a send_on_approval one-sentence statement of what the send does and to how many.

checks.description: Suppression excludes unsubscribes and hard bounces (and paying where applicable).
checks.rule: Output suppression names unsubscribed and hard-bounced, and the flow excludes them.

checks.description: The platform open item is surfaced; the package is not-sendable until confirmed and approved.
checks.rule: Body marks the platform open item and marks the package design-only and not-sendable until the platform is confirmed and approved.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals, empowering not deficit-framed, RTL-safe Arabic.
checks.rule: File contains no em dash, no tatweel, no Eastern Arabic numerals; any Arabic example is empowering and RTL-safe.
